scope: Current source-bound functional failure with explicit public timing.
rule: Bind this spec/DUT/diagnosis. Check initial, reset, edge, enable, state and output rules against RTL; mark each SPECIFIED, UNSPECIFIED, AMBIGUOUS or NOT_OBSERVED. Check width only if relevant. Use public quotes and current RTL; separate contradictions from hypotheses. Pick one primary hypothesis and minimal edit via edit_dut; then verify_rtl. In edited source include one inert line comment SKILL01_SUMMARY: JSON with rules (initial/reset/edge/enable/state/output), spec_quote (exact public text), rtl_quote (exact old RTL), hypothesis, action, limitations. It is evidence of a summary, not proof. Existing Host verification records outcome and unresolved failures.
limitations: Only authorized spec, DUT, current diagnostics and bounded feedback/history. Unknown rules stay unknown. No oracle, past answers, exact cycle/expected-actual or proven cause inferred. No blanket initial/always_ff ban. One registered tool per response; edit then verify; only Host determines PASS.
